parsed.rationale: Both participating records carry `is_test: true` and reside in `Shared/Core/Tests/CoreTests/HTTPURLResponseValidationTests.swift`. The two methods — `successStatusCodesDoNotThrow` and `nonSuccessStatusCodesThrow` — are complementary test cases that intentionally exercise opposite branches of HTTP status-code validation logic; their structural similarity (Jaccard 0.8) reflects the symmetric nature of the test domain, not accidental duplication. Merging or genericizing them would obscure the distinct failure modes each test is designed to catch and would couple test semantics to production code. No refactor is warranted.
